sports.headline: Big 12 commissioner Brett Yormark to become CEO of RedBird's new Milan Sports & Entertainment
sports.summary: Sportico reports that Brett Yormark is leaving the Big 12 to run RedBird Capital's new Milan Sports & Entertainment holding company. The company is built around AC Milan, the planned new stadium, a possible NBA Europe franchise and a tennis venue. He reports to Gerry Cardinale and starts after leaving the Big 12 at the end of January 2027.

sports.headline: ATP Finals: tour sponsorship revenue jumps a record 49% to pass US$100m for the first time
sports.summary: SportsPro's business preview of the Turin season-ender says the ATP's central sponsorship revenue rose 49% this year, passing US$100m for the first time. It also covers new deals with EQT, K-Swiss and Julius Baer, and notes the stalled planned WTA merger and the congested calendar.

fashion.headline: Frasers installs David Epstein as Hugo Boss CEO as Daniel Grieder steps down
fashion.summary: Hugo Boss named Frasers Group's chief brand partnerships officer David Epstein as CEO from 1 January 2027, succeeding Daniel Grieder. The move comes after Frasers took majority control in October and deepens its grip on the German fashion group. Hugo Boss has also had a run of senior departures and recently cut its 2026 outlook.

fashion.headline: Burberry posts fifth straight quarter of comparable sales growth as turnaround gains traction
fashion.summary: Burberry's first-half revenue rose 6% to £1.1bn and adjusted operating profit more than tripled to £62m. Comparable retail sales were up 4%, led by the Americas and Greater China, with double-digit outerwear growth. Shares jumped almost 10%, though EMEIA sales slipped and no interim dividend was declared.

fashion.headline: Asics shares sink 14%, the most since 2024, as earnings disappoint
fashion.summary: Asics shares closed 14% lower in Tokyo after third-quarter results missed analyst expectations. The company held its full-year operating income outlook at ¥195bn, below the consensus estimate. Nine-month sales were strong overseas, but margins were squeezed as the sportswear market slows.

marketing.headline: La Sportiva launches 'Nothing But Mountain' global brand platform with agency Mynt
marketing.summary: The Italian outdoor performance brand has unveiled a long-term global communications platform built around a manifesto film narrated by climber Pietro Dal Prà. The platform is meant to unify how the brand communicates worldwide and will be developed through future campaigns.
